CKEditor from ui-components is a text area shown as CKEditor 5, a complete editor with its own toolbar, balloons and dialogs, in the colors of the theme. It keeps the contract of the Rich Text Editor, Tiptap, so that an application can switch between the two: the text is HTML, or Markdown, kept in a text area a form posts; it can be read only, show a placeholder, count the words and be resized by the bar along its bottom; the server keeps its state, what you selected, how far you scrolled and the size you gave it; Ctrl+S saves, and the tabs and the desktop show changes not saved.

The library holds no code of CKEditor, which is licensed under the GPL 2 or later, or under the commercial terms of CKSource. The application brings it, the browser build of the ckeditor5 package of npm or a build of its own, and its license key, a setting of the application. This demo brings the browser build and runs it under the GPL, with the license key GPL: CKEditor then shows its Powered by badge.

The server never trusts the HTML of the browser: it cleans it before it keeps it, keeping only what the plugins of the editor write. Everything works under a strict Content Security Policy: the HTML has no style attribute, text aligns by classes, and images have no width or height.
